Hausbuch.title: House book
Hausbuch.body: The house book holds the rules your workspace books by: how a particular counterparty is booked, for example, or what happens with VAT. Every agent reads them first and follows them. A house rule never books anything itself, it is a hint. When an agent writes a house rule, it waits in Pendenzen for your approval. Under What agents see you find what an agent learns about your books first.
